#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    int a[6] = {0};
    if (n > 0) cin >> a[0];
    if (n > 1) cin >> a[1];
    if (n > 2) cin >> a[2];
    if (n > 3) cin >> a[3];
    if (n == 5) cin >> a[4];

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n - i - 1; ++j) {
            if (a[j] > a[j + 1]) {
                swap(a[j], a[j + 1]);
            }
        }
    }

    int t = (a[0] + a[n - 1]) >> 1;
    int left = -1, right = n;
    while (++left < n && a[left] <= t);
    while (--right >= 0 && a[right] >= t);
    int candidate1 = (left > 0 && abs(a[left - 1] - t) < abs(a[left] - t)) ? a[left - 1] : a[left];
    int candidate2 = (right >= 0 && abs(a[right] - t) < abs(a[right + 1] - t)) ? a[right] : a[right + 1];
    cout << (abs(a[left] - t) < abs(a[right] - t) ? candidate1 : candidate2) << "\n";
    return 0;
}
